paper.title: MMRC: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Understanding Multimodal Large Language Model in Real-World Conversation

evidence.section: Abstract; benchmark design and task taxonomy
evidence.figure_or_table: Benchmark overview and main evaluation tables
evidence.paraphrase: Real-world multimodal conversations directly evaluate extraction, multi-turn reasoning, information update, image management, memory recall, and answer refusal.

adjudication_notes: Retained as memory-adjacent because it evaluates conversational memory behavior rather than prescribing a persistent agent-memory architecture.

2026-09-17 scope review: History-conditioned probes explicitly test memory recall, image management and information updates, alongside cross-turn reasoning. The former dagger is not justified. Memory-related ability tracks; other MMRC tasks are broader dialogue tests. The legacy scope_status field is not a Table 2 exclusion rule.
